premise: Acorn wants to be as big as the great trees right now; Squirrel tucks her into the soft earth before the snow, and when the spring sun comes Acorn feels a tickle in her toes — a root growing down first.
inspiration: "Great oaks from little acorns grow" (proverb) and the small-seed folk motif, turned toward patience: the first growing happens where nobody can see it.
lesson: Big things start small, and some growing happens out of sight.
learning: An acorn grows a root down into the ground first, before its shoot grows up.

en-US.title: Acorn Wants to Be a Tree
en-US.text: {acorn:enter} Acorn looked up at the two great trees. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x2} [excited] I want to be big like them. Right NOW! {squirrel:enter} Squirrel came bounding by. [giggles] Right now? Then she {squirrel:live} hid her hazelnut behind her back. [whispers] Want to know a secret? Big trees start small, hidden in the ground. {squirrel:go to acorn} So before winter, Squirrel {sfx:pat} tucked Acorn into the soft earth. {squirrel:hearts} Beside them, {flower:enter} Flower {flower:tint #BFE3FF} shivered in the cold and {flower:live hold} folded up tight. {canvas:snow 0.6 20s} Then the snowflakes came. {acorn:live hold} Acorn closed her eyes and wished. Grow… grow… GROW! {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} One morning, the sun came back and melted the snow away. {flower:live resume} Flower opened wide. And Acorn felt a tickle in her toes. {acorn:live resume} [gasps] Am I a tree? {acorn:face surprised} {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:hop} Not yet, said Squirrel. That's your root, going down first. The shoot comes up next. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:glow} Down first, then up! [softly] And for once, Acorn didn't mind waiting at all.

es-ES.title: Bellota quiere ser un árbol
es-ES.text: {acorn:enter} Bellota miró hacia arriba, a los dos árboles grandes. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x2} [excited] ¡Quiero ser grande como ellos! ¡YA MISMO! {squirrel:enter} Ardilla pasó dando brincos. [giggles] ¿Ya mismo? Y {squirrel:live} escondió su avellana detrás de la espalda. [whispers] ¿Te cuento un secreto? Los árboles grandes empiezan pequeñitos, escondidos bajo tierra. {squirrel:go to acorn} Así que, antes del invierno, Ardilla {sfx:pat} arropó a Bellota en la tierra blanda. {squirrel:hearts} A su lado, {flower:enter} Flor {flower:tint #BFE3FF} tiritó de frío y {flower:live hold} se cerró bien cerradita. {canvas:snow 0.6 20s} Entonces llegaron los copos de nieve. {acorn:live hold} Bellota cerró los ojos y pidió un deseo. Crecer… crecer… ¡CRECER! {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Una mañana volvió el sol y derritió la nieve. {flower:live resume} Flor se abrió de par en par. Y Bellota notó cosquillas en los pies. {acorn:live resume} [gasps] ¿Ya soy un árbol? {acorn:face surprised} {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:hop} Todavía no, dijo Ardilla. Es tu raíz, que baja primero. Luego sube el tallo. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:glow} ¡Primero abajo, luego arriba! [softly] Y, por una vez, a Bellota no le importó nada esperar.

pat.prompt: small paws gently patting down soft earth, close, realistic
